title: Coagulation Blood Collection Tubes
desc: For coagulation studies Action principle and advantage : Coagulation tubes are filled with buffered tri-sodium citrate solution. The mixing ratio is 1 part citrate to 9 parts blood with advantage of high accurate blood-to-additive ratio. It can provide an excellent condition for the blood coagulation studies. Additive : 3.2% Sodium Citrate Specimen
